name: smart-wallet-mint
title: Mint
notes:
• The wallet NFT is minted once under the script's own policy; spending the seed_utxo makes it one-shot.
• wallet_addr = hash(smart_wallet(seed, settings_ref, wallet_nft_name, admin)).
• Every script in the initial spenders and depositors maps is registered here with its Publish redeemer.
• The wallet UTxO carries the NFT, an inline datum and no reference script.
